title: Fix signup flow gating and debug persistent signup issue

requirements.text: Fix the new-user signup gating by ensuring that an authenticated principal without an existing profile can reach the ProfileSetup screen (i.e., profile lookup must not trap/throw for new users). Update the backend so `getCallerUserProfile()` returns `null` when the caller has no profile yet, instead of trapping due to missing `#user` permission.
acceptanceCriteria: After authenticating with Internet Identity as a brand-new principal (no stored profile), the app loads the ProfileSetup form (not SessionInvalidScreen).
`getCallerUserProfile()` does not trap for an authenticated caller who has not signed up yet; it returns `null`.
Existing behavior remains unchanged for users with profiles: `getCallerUserProfile()` returns the stored profile.

requirements.text: Harden the frontend session-invalid detection so that failures during profile fetch that indicate a missing signup/profile do not route the user to SessionInvalidScreen. Ensure the UI treats the “no profile yet” condition as expected and continues into ProfileSetup rather than showing a stale-session recovery flow.
acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated and the backend indicates the user has no profile yet, the app renders ProfileSetup instead of SessionInvalidScreen.
SessionInvalidScreen is shown only for genuine authentication/session failures (e.g., invalid/expired delegation), not for expected new-user states.
No infinite loading loop occurs between login, profile fetch, and ProfileSetup.

requirements.text: Add targeted signup/profile-flow debugging output (console logging) in the frontend to make the persistent signup issue diagnosable in production builds: log the login status, whether identity is present, profile query status (loading/fetched), and any profile-fetch error message (sanitized to avoid leaking sensitive data).
acceptanceCriteria: When running the app and reproducing the signup flow, the browser console includes clear logs for: authentication state, profile fetch state, and any encountered error message.
The logs do not include secrets (e.g., URL secret parameters such as `caffeineAdminToken`) or personally identifying form inputs (name/email/mobile/password).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if an upgrade of stable state is required.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding a password-based authentication system (the password field in the signup form remains frontend-only unless separately requested).
Changing report creation/history/admin features unrelated to the signup gating issue.
